Description: It was observed that the Lifeboat hatch was not closing properly and was thus not gas tight.

Following Condition of Class (Machinery) was issued COC nr. LBN0/2024/XXXX - Temporary repairs on electrical cable pipe ducts on Main Deck to be definitively repaired before the limit date. Due date 27-Jul-2026

Forward winch hydraulic oil reservoir tank gauge glass closing device (bottom) was noted to be leaking approximately a drop every minute and oil could be seen covering one fifth of the area within it's save all. Reportedly the 'O' ring for the coupling was damaged.
One of the stud for the starboard chain locker bulkhead manhole was noted to be broken from the base with part of the stud remaining within the threaded hole.
Gyro compass No 1 was observed to be displaying a persistent error and the heading was about 10° off.
